items.title: Revolut Starts EURR Rollout With Bridge as Regulated Issuer
items.summary: Revolut opens EURR to selected customers in three countries; Bridge reported €374 outstanding, compared with €394.5 million of Circle’s EURC.

items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: Anthony Armstrong, former CFO at Elon Musk’s xAI and X, joins Coinbase board
items.summary: Anthony Armstrong — no relation to Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong — most recently served as CFO across xAI, X.AI Corp., and X Corp.

items.title: Coinbase launches regulated crypto derivatives in Canada
items.summary: Coinbase is offering eligible Canadian traders perpetual and dated futures with up to 10x leverage as major US trading platforms expand their crypto presence in Canada.
